instructions: Complete the summary below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.
stem_block:
Analysing the glass from the skull

The dark material found inside the young man's skull proved to be brain tissue turned straight into a glassy solid. Such a change is very rare, since it happens only where tissue is made hot enough, fast enough, for ordinary (36) ........ never to begin, and is then chilled again before it burns away. Several methods were combined to test the identification: an electron microscope showed the fine internal structure of the glass, X-rays gave its chemical make-up, a purpose-built image-processing routine picked out the regular pattern of the covering around nerve fibres, and a check against (37) ........ of brain proteins independently confirmed where the tissue came from. The measurements were strikingly detailed. Nerve fibres were close in width to those of a living brain, their coverings kept a layered form, and even the (38) ........ , the smallest structures the team reports, were still in place. Chemistry pointed the same way: (39) ........ proteins that occur only in brain tissue were identified, one of them needed for signals to pass between nerve cells. The authors conclude that only a very narrow band of (40) ........ could have left the tissue both scorched and structurally intact, since anything slower would have ruined it.

items.prompt: Such a change is very rare, since it happens only where tissue is made hot enough, fast enough, for ordinary (36) ........ never to begin, and is then chilled again before it burns away.
items.evidence: Vitrification of this kind is exceptionally rare in the natural world because it demands a very particular sequence of events: organic material must be heated fast enough and to a high enough temperature to prevent normal decomposition, and then cooled again almost as quickly, before it has time to burn away entirely.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says that for vitrification to occur, the tissue must be heated fast enough and to a high enough temperature to prevent normal decomposition; so the answer is 'decomposition'.

items.review_note: E5 / 8. calistirma: dokunulmadi. Model uc turda da 'decay' verdi; kabul listesi yalniz 'decomposition' kabul ettigi icin 3 turun 0'inda puan alirdi. Bas ad zorunlu: 'dokunun cok cabuk isitilmasi yuzunden siradan ___ hic baslamadi' cercevesinde curume disinda bir kavram okunamaz. Sorunun gercek kusuru cerceve degil, kabul listesinin darligi - o da korunan bir alan.

items.prompt: ... and a check against (37) ........ of brain proteins independently confirmed where the tissue came from.
items.evidence: Finally, comparison against reference databases of proteins expressed in the human brain provided independent confirmation of the tissue's origin.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the tissue's origin was independently confirmed by comparing it against reference databases of proteins expressed in the human brain; so the answer is 'reference databases'.

Bas ad zorunlu: 'beyin proteinlerinin ___ ile karsilastirilmasi' cercevesinde veri tabani disinda bir sey okunamaz. Duzeltme yarim kalirdi.

items.prompt: Nerve fibres were close in width to those of a living brain, their coverings kept a layered form, and even the (38) ........ , the smallest structures the team reports, were still in place.
items.evidence: Even microtubules, the tiny internal scaffolding of individual cells, were still visible, measuring around 23 nanometres in diameter.
items.explanation: Paragraph E lists what survived in the vitrified tissue and ends with the microtubules, the smallest structures it records; so the answer is 'microtubules'.
items.flag_reason: Cevap 'microtubules', cumlenin kendisi bosluktan hemen sonra terimin tanimini veriyor ('the minute rods that support a cell from within'); bu tanim, terimi bilenler icin dogrudan cagristirdigindan parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.

revision.onceki_prompt: Nerve fibres were close in width to those of a living brain, their coverings kept a layered form, and even the (38) ........ , the minute rods that support a cell from within, could still be measured at roughly 23 nanometres.
revision.ne_degisti: Bosluktan hemen sonra gelen ac tanim ('the minute rods that support a cell from within') kaldirildi - bu, 'microtubules' sozcugunun sozluk karsiligiydi ve terimi bilen bir cozucuye cevabi dogrudan veriyordu. Ayrica taniyla birlikte calisan 23 nanometrelik olcu de ozetten cikarildi (microtubul capi ~25 nm olarak bilinir). Yerine, hicbir sey tanimlamayan bir sira bilgisi kondu; yeni cerceveye pasajin kendi dunyasindan birden cok aday uyuyor (cell bodies, myelin sheaths, microtubules), secim yalniz E/4'ten yapilabiliyor.

items.prompt: Chemistry pointed the same way: (39) ........ proteins that occur only in brain tissue were identified, one of them needed for signals to pass between nerve cells.
items.evidence: The team detected seven distinct proteins known to be expressed specifically in brain tissue, including one involved in stabilising the internal skeleton of nerve cells and another essential for communication between neurons.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says seven distinct proteins known to occur only in brain tissue were identified; so the answer is 'seven'.

items.prompt: The authors conclude that only a very narrow band of (40) ........ could have left the tissue both scorched and structurally intact.
items.evidence: Researchers argue that only an extremely narrow set of thermal conditions, rapid heating followed by almost immediate cooling, could have produced this particular combination of extreme temperature exposure and structural preservation, since either slower heating or slower cooling would most likely have destroyed the tissue rather than turning it to glass.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says only a very narrow set of thermal conditions could explain both the extreme heat exposure and the preservation of the structure; so the answer is 'thermal conditions'.

revision.ne_degisti: Boslugun hemen ardindaki cizgi arasi ac tanim ('heat applied in an instant, then cooling almost at once') kaldirildi - bu, 'thermal' niteleyicisinin ozetteki tek kaynagiydi ve model uc turda da bas adi ('conditions') veriyordu. Niteleyici artik yalniz G/2'den okunabiliyor.
